products.name: Captions AI
products.note: AI video editing; eye contact correction; dubbing; likeness manipulation consent

profile_text.body:
Captions is an AI video generator and editor, accessible via its app at captions.ai, that the company describes as making it easy to go from idea to ready-to-share content regardless of a user's editing skill level. The platform is pitched at content creators producing short-form social videos, ads, tutorials, promotional content, and real estate listing videos, among other formats. The company describes its AI as understanding a user's story and tailoring edits to specific footage, handling tasks such as cutting scenes, overlaying B-roll, auto-generating captions, and producing translated subtitles automatically.

The core product, Captions AI, includes tools for eye contact correction, dubbing, and likeness manipulation with consent, as well as the ability to create an AI twin or choose from digital avatars that can be directed via prompts to change outfits, backgrounds, or product inserts. Additional features listed include a script-to-video workflow, a text-based video editor, a transition editor, and a prompt-to-video capability, all oriented toward reducing the manual effort traditionally associated with video production.

The held facts record Captions as a tracked product in the video generation and editing category, with no litigation, SEC filings, MCP server registrations, or patent facts currently on file for the company.
